title: DARWIN: a Geospatial Foundation Model for Marine Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2611.22496v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present DARWIN, a geospatial foundation model for marine intelligence. Recent Earth-observation foundation models have concentrated on terrestrial domains. The marine realm poses distinct challenges: missingness, multi-modal physical and biogeochemical variables, sparse labels, and dynamics that are transient, multi-scale, and non stationary over time. DARWIN adapts a masked-autoencoder backbone to these properties through missingness-aware encoding, expanded spatial and temporal masking, and Fourier-style positional embeddings, and is pretrained on 26 years of global Copernicus reanalysis together with GEBCO bathymetry.   On predicting chlorophyll-a, the pretrained backbone attains the lowest monthly relative error in every month of 2022, outperforming both no-encoder baselines and an identically architected random-init encoder. translated_title: DARWIN：面向海洋智能的地理空间基础模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了DARWIN，一个面向海洋智能的地理空间基础模型。近期的地球观测基础模型主要集中于陆地领域，而海洋领域带来了独特的挑战：数据缺失、多模态的物理与生物地球化学变量、稀疏的标签，以及瞬态、多尺度且随时间非平稳的动态特性。DARWIN通过缺失感知编码、扩展的空间与时间掩码以及傅里叶式位置嵌入，将掩码自编码器骨干网络适配到这些特性上，并在26年的全球Copernicus再分析数据以及GEBCO测深数据上进行预训练。在预测叶绿素-a方面，该预训练骨干网络在2022年的每个月都取得了最低的月度相对误差，优于无编码器基线模型以及采用相同架构的随机初始化编码器。仅使用10%的有监督训练数据时，DARWIN就已超越使用100%训练数据训练的随机初始化模型。
tldr: DARWIN是首个针对海洋数据缺失、多模态、稀疏标签和非平稳动态等特性而设计的地理空间基础模型，通过改进的掩码自编码器在26年全球海洋再分析数据上预训练，在叶绿素-a预测任务中仅用10%的有监督数据就超越了用全量数据训练的随机初始化模型。
en_tdlr: DARWIN is a geospatial foundation model designed for marine data challenges—missingness, multimodal variables, sparse labels, and non-stationary dynamics—pretrained via an adapted masked autoencoder on 26 years of global ocean reanalysis data, achieving superior chlorophyll-a prediction with only 10% of the supervised training data compared to a randomly initialized model trained on the full dataset.
